MagicAmmo.title: Magic Ammunition
MagicAmmo.intro: Add {name} as it is, or attach one missile talent. Optionally mark it cursed.

IntelligentWeapon.powersHint: Primary and extraordinary powers go on the Special Abilities / Spells tab. Will includes each linked extraordinary power.

MagicSword.title: Magic Weapon
MagicSword.intro: Add {name} as it is, or attach one additional modifier (opponent bonus or talent — not both). Optionally mark it cursed.
MagicSword.cursedDescription: Cursed. Magical bonuses are penalties. The wielder cannot willingly discard it once used in battle (unequip blocked for non-GM). Compulsion to always use it in battle is manual. Remove curse / dispel evil may lift the compulsion or restore the weapon per RC.

MagicArmor.title: Magic Armor
MagicArmor.intro: Add {name} as it is, or attach one special power.

SyncEmbedded.title: Update Embedded Items from Compendium
SyncEmbedded.hint: Update copies definition data on actor-embedded items from fade-compendiums. State such as quantity, charges, cast counts, memorized counts, and skill level is preserved.
SyncEmbedded.gmOnly: You must be a GM to update embedded items from the compendium.
SyncEmbedded.working: Updating embedded items from the compendium…
SyncEmbedded.done: Embedded item sync finished. Updated: {updated}. No source match: {missing}. Skipped: {skipped}.
